title: Refine reviewed paired-cube stopping parameters to conditional κ = 0.000461144586716
body:
Reviewed main's paired-cube bit supplier uses atom exponent `1/1000`, although
its complete stopped-recursion cost bound admits a smaller fixed exponent.
This parameter refinement on main `d1d6c070f5a8c684727ee7ec35d930f9ebfa9758`
certifies

$$
\kappa=115286146679/250000000000000=0.000461144586716,
$$

a 0.04939865% increase over `0.0004609169`. It adds three isolated research
files: a written dependence/cost argument, a reproducible generator/checker,
and a source-bound exact certificate. The historical selected result remains
its own reviewed checkpoint.

For coarse saving A and old leaf saving L, the effective bit saving is
`a=(1-theta)A+theta*L`. The retained strict adapter toll is equivalent to
`theta>A/(1+A-L)`. Choose the first strictly admissible `10^-18` grid point,
refine A using the existing independent maintainer's two-sided rational
log/exp enclosures, and re-instantiate the retained assembly at eta=`10^-14`.
The entire rare-class fallback, rank moment, borrowed-row restoration,
dirty-response charge, finite group/router stock, external reserve and
semantic guard remain paid. All 47 strict constraints and seven cost
margins pass. A mathematical lower enclosure rejects the next coarse-saving
grid point; additional controls reject the previous atom grid, next headline
grid and zero eta. A scoped upper bound places this witness within
`2*10^-15` of the supremum for this fixed contaminated profile, leaf supplier,
strict toll and retained assembly family.

Reproduce from the repository root:

```sh
make paired-cube-verify
python3 -B research/paired-cube-stop-refinement/verify.py --check research/paired-cube-stop-refinement/certificate.json
python3 -B research/paired-cube-stop-refinement/verify.py --output /tmp/stop-refinement.json
cmp /tmp/stop-refinement.json research/paired-cube-stop-refinement/certificate.json
make verify
```

Local selected reconstruction and the new certificate pass; regeneration is
byte-identical. Optimized Python modes are rejected before writing output.
`make verify` passed through the historical research group and skip-strips,
then stopped in inherited skip-suffix verification because Apple Clang
rejects `-fopenmp`. An inherited positive-frame build additionally needs
unavailable Boost multiprecision headers. The full suite is not claimed
to pass. The follow-up `make -k` run passed clones, split-pair, joint
composition, pair assembly, all 79 isolated test modules and all 20 historical
patch-application checks; it returned exit 2 because of the positive-frame
build failure. Local logs and the validation receipt were retained in the author’s review
package; the committed proof and certificate provide the reproduction evidence. Lean/Lake were unavailable locally; no new formal
verification is claimed.

The toll-tightening principle is already explored by gupt1156 in PR148 and
Abhinav Ramachandran in PR158; no priority is claimed. This submission applies
it directly to reviewed main, certifies a finer contaminated-moment root and
provides a scoped ceiling. Several pending circuit PRs claim larger exponents;
their finite words and dependency audits are separate from this main-based
refinement.

Credits remain with icekylinx (PR144/130/115/104), an664 (PR128), eumemic
(PR117), Zhihao Chen (PR97), Swapnil Jain, PR23/RaD, the original OpenAI #109
framework and its analytic predecessors. Prepared with substantial OpenAI
Codex assistance. Apache-2.0; existing notices remain unchanged.

The bound remains conditional on every retained analytic, uniform-recursion,
exact-recovery and fixed-tape interface. No full formal multiplication proof,
unconditional theorem, global optimum or practical speedup is claimed.
